notes.title: New Quests Update! - March 2024
notes.notes:
[h1]Thank you to everyone who has downloaded the game! We hope you are still enjoying the game and working hard to advance your careers
[/h1]

[h2]In this update we are introducing bug fixes and new quests.
[/h2]

You can look forward to doing some quests with extraterrestrials you've never helped before! Including one character who is pretty friendly... we'll leave some easter eggs on this post to help you out. Every quest offers a unique reward for your office, including more choices for wallpaper, rugs and chairs.

We've fixed a bug with the quest dialog bubbles that weren't appearing before. Also if you exit the game and sign in as a different user, we've fixed the task assignment bug there so you no longer get the previous users tasks. 

If you notice any other bugs, let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Museum Update!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]To those who have downloaded the game, thank you. We hope you have had as much fun playing it as we have had making it.[/b][/h3]

Today we have released a new update including, background music, bug fixes and UI sizing modifications that should make the game even more enjoyable.

The background music has been designed to be loop-able and have a nice beat to listen to while you are busy working at the Museum. In case you love it, we've added a setting to increase the volume to as loud as you want it, or if your prefer your own bops, you may lower the sound to zero.

Next year we hope to add more quests and tasks to the game for all career levels. So be on the lookout for the next major update!

Be safe and have a happy New Year! 


p.s. In case you come across any bugs or want to send the team a message, find us over at our blog here! - http://speedtrapstudios.com
